# besselj1f

> Compute the [Bessel function of the first kind][bessel-first-kind] of order one for a single-precision floating-point number.

<section class="intro">

The [Bessel function of the first kind][bessel-first-kind] of order one is defined as

<!-- <equation class="equation" label="eq:bessel_first_kind_order_one" align="center" raw="J_1 (x) = \frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{-\pi}^\pi e^{i(\tau - x \sin(\tau))} \,d\tau" alt="Bessel function of the first kind of order one"> -->

```math
J_1 (x) = \frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{-\pi}^\pi e^{i(\tau - x \sin(\tau))} \,d\tau
```

<!-- <div class="equation" align="center" data-raw-text="J_1 (x) = \frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{-\pi}^\pi e^{i(\tau - x \sin(\tau))} \,d\tau" data-equation="eq:bessel_first_kind_order_one">
    <img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/stdlib-js/stdlib@01b4d1e7171ba8c0496257918223559819273f98/lib/node_modules/@stdlib/math/base/special/besselj1f/docs/img/equation_bessel_first_kind_order_one.svg" alt="Bessel function of the first kind of order one">
    <br>
</div> -->

<!-- </equation> -->

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var besselj1f = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/besselj1f' );
```

#### besselj1f( x )

Computes the [Bessel function of the first kind][bessel-first-kind] of order one for a single-precision floating-point number.

```javascript
var v = besselj1f( 0.0 );
// returns 0.0

v = besselj1f( 1.0 );
// returns ~0.440

v = besselj1f( Infinity );
// returns 0.0

v = besselj1f( -Infinity );
// returns 0.0

v = besselj1f( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var uniform = require( '@stdlib/random/array/uniform' );
var logEachMap = require( '@stdlib/console/log-each-map' );
var besselj1f = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/besselj1f' );

var opts = {
    'dtype': 'float32'
};
var x = uniform( 100, 0.0, 100.0, opts );

logEachMap( 'besselj1f(%0.4f) = %0.4f', x, besselj1f );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<section class="usage">

### Usage

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/besselj1f.h"
```

#### stdlib_base_besselj1f( x )

Computes the [Bessel function of the first kind][bessel-first-kind] of order one for a single-precision floating-point number.

```c
float out = stdlib_base_besselj1f( 0.0f );
// returns 0.0f

out = stdlib_base_besselj1f( 1.0f );
// returns ~0.440f
```

The function accepts the following arguments:

-   **x**: `[in] float` input value.

```c
float stdlib_base_besselj1f( const float x );
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- C API usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

### Examples

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/besselj1f.h"
#include <stdio.h>

int main( void ) {
    const float x[] = { 0.0f, 0.005f, 3.14f, 10.0f, 51.125f, 99.99f, 100.0f };

    float v;
    int i;
    for ( i = 0; i < 7; i++ ) {
        v = stdlib_base_besselj1f( x[ i ] );
        printf( "J1(%f) = %f\n", x[ i ], v );
    }
}
```

</section>
